documents.text: Employees receive twenty days of vacation annually. Vacation requests require ten business days notice.
Security incidents must be reported to the security team within one hour. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory.
Travel expenses require manager approval. Hotel reimbursement is limited to two hundred dollars per night.
